nodes.label: Raster Logo (Light Variant)
nodes.rationale: Light-background variant of the project logo: wordmark drawn in near-black #16171d so it reads on light themes (e.g. GitHub light README). Built entirely from 1-unit rects with shape-rendering=crispEdges so it stays pixel-sharp at any scale, reflecting the pixel-art nature of the Raster editor.

nodes.label: Pixel-Art R App Icon Mark
nodes.rationale: 10x10 dark rounded square containing a pixel-drawn letter R striped in four horizontal color bands (blue #5b8cff, green #4ade80, yellow #ffd166, pink #ff6b8b), evoking a raster/scanline pixel grid.

nodes.label: Raster Pixel Wordmark
nodes.rationale: The word 'Raster' set in a hand-built 7px-tall bitmap font, scaled 6/7 to align with the icon mark.

nodes.label: Raster Brand Color Palette
nodes.rationale: Four accent colors (#5b8cff blue, #4ade80 green, #ffd166 yellow, #ff6b8b pink) on dark base #16171d define the brand identity.

nodes.label: Crisp-Edges Pixel Rendering
nodes.rationale: shape-rendering=crispEdges with integer-grid rects prevents anti-aliasing so the vector logo renders as hard-edged pixel art.
